title: RewardModel-CrossDataset: A Generalization Benchmark for Reward Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Measuring reward model cross-dataset generalization reveals brittleness in RLHF pipelines. Impact is real but the finding (models overfit to their training distribution) is somewhat expected; the value is in quantifying the gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training 2-3 reward models on HH-RLHF and evaluating on multiple target datasets requires significant ML engineering. Reward model training is not beginner-level work even with existing libraries.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Training multiple reward models and evaluating on multiple cross-dataset benchmarks is a multi-arm experiment. Each reward model training run is time-consuming. Too broad for 30 hours.
